asserts: A trace recorded under rule v1 says so in two fields, and neither of them carries what the rule took. The `env:` field counts the environment the trace HOLDS and names the variables that were redacted out of it (`(2 vars, 1 redacted: SECRET_TOKEN)`) -- names only, because a digest printed beside the name it belongs to is an offline guessing target for any short value, and the digest `0123456789abcdef` this trace carries must appear nowhere in the output. The `redaction:` line, directly under `caps:`, states the parameters of the recording: which rule, that the store could key it and which key, and whose hand last applied it. A reader who cannot see those two fields cannot tell a trace whose secrets were taken out from one whose secrets are still in it.

questions.ask: Which variables did the rule take out of this recording's environment, and what rule was the recording made under?
expect_contains: redaction: rule v1, keyed (key 0a1b2c3d), by recorder
